finalists.label: Ewing's Sarcoma
finalists.why: Diffuse positivity for CD99, KIT, and cyclin D1 and microscopic features of small, round hyperchromatic cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios and frequent mitoses.

finalists.label: Sarcoma
finalists.why: Microscopic features of sheets of small, round hyperchromatic cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, frequent mitoses, pseudo-rosette formation, foci of cytoplasmic clearing, and necrosis.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is decided by the specific immunohistochemical stains showing diffuse positivity for CD99, KIT, and cyclin D1, which are characteristic of Ewing's Sarcoma.

support_spans: grossly, the specimen was a detached, fragmented, ill-defined mass (14 × 12 × 4 cm) with fleshy solid and cystic components, central hemorrhage, and necrosis

microscopically, the tumor invaded from the serosal surface into the myometrium and comprised sheets of small, round hyperchromatic cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, frequent mitoses (32 per 10 high-power fields), pseudo-rosette formation, foci of cytoplasmic clearing, and necrosis
